messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (INC-2112345678) — cross-region routing anomalies detected. Metric alerts: region-heartbeat=missing for eu-west-1a and fallback-rate spike on edge routers. Auto-page: alice_sre_oncall.

alice_sre_oncall: on it. seeing a rise in 5xxs and p50/p95 latency to 2x for requests routed to eu-west. can anyone confirm if there's an AZ/heartbeat problem?

ben_net_eng: I'm seeing intermittent telemetry from aws eu-west-1a: health-checks are timing out from our edge pop to regional gateway. traceroute shows paths exist but connection resets. not sure if BGP/peering or local firewall.

carmen_support: Customer impact: support dashboard shows ~7% of requests failing for customers pinned to eu-west region, mainly enterprise accounts with regional pinning. raising P1 to notify CSMs.

diego_prod: quick check — routing-policy v3.12 rolled out ~02:42 UTC canary. the policy change included aggressive latency steering with automatic fallback. could be oscillation where heartbeat flaps triggered a cascade.

elaine_reliability: confirmed: policy evaluation logs show repeated 'region_down' decisions for eu-west-1a despite healthy instances in eu-west-1b/c. looks like heartbeat source is tied to AZ-specific probe that mis-attributed failures.

alice_sre_oncall: plan: (1) temporarily pin routing for affected customers to eu-west-1b (2) rollback v3.12 steering rules to v3.11 canary config (3) flush edge DNS cache for eu-west endpoints, lower TTL. doing (1) now.

ben_net_eng: ping me for the pin script. i'm preparing a route patch.

alice_sre_oncall: executing pin patch for the top 50 enterprise accounts to eu-west-1b:
```
rdctl routing pin --customer-list top50_enterprise.csv --region eu-west-1b --reason "incident INC-2112345678 temporary pin"
```

alice_sre_oncall: result: 48/50 successful, 2 failed (timeouts) — retrying the 2.

ben_net_eng: rolling back steering policy to v3.11 now. CLI: 
```
opsctl rollout revert --service=geo-router --from v3.12 --to v3.11 --force
```

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by ben_net_eng at 2026-02-11T03:00:12Z. Canary traffic will be evaluated for 2 minutes.

alice_sre_oncall: rollback complete, canary looks stable. traffic distribution back to expected. latency p95 improving.

elaine_reliability: flushing edge DNS cache and reducing TTL from 60s -> 15s for eu-west endpoints to speed remediation. command: `edgectl cache flush --region eu-west`

carmen_support: sending templated update to impacted customers and CSMs now. note: two customers still showing elevated error rates. adding targeted retry/redirect in-app for them.

ben_net_eng: digging deeper on heartbeat source. found a config drift on probe cluster in eu-west-1a — health-check agents were mis-tagging AZ suffix due to a recent packaging change. opening config-fix PR.

diego_prod: what's the customer impact % after rollback/pins? metrics?

alice_sre_oncall: current numbers: overall error rate back down from 7% -> 1.2%. impacted customer count down to 2 major customers, ~0.4% of total traffic. keeping incident open for postmortem.

elaine_reliability: next steps: (A) revert probe packaging change in eu-west agent cluster (B) add sanity check to routing policy to require region-level quorum, not single-AZ heartbeat (C) create eval to replay traffic against v3.12 variant to verify fix. adding tickets.

ben_net_eng: PR created: infra/probes#278 — revert change + add AZ tagging unit test. I'm pushing hotfix to eu-west probe fleet now.

ops-bot: Hotfix deployment started to eu-west probes by ben_net_eng at 2026-02-11T03:12:40Z.

alice_sre_oncall: hotfix applied, manual smoke: probes now return consistent region status. heartbeat events normalized.

carmen_support: status page draft: "We experienced cross-region routing anomalies affecting a subset of customers pinned to eu-west. Traffic has been stabilized via temporary routing pins and rollback of a steering policy change. Investigating root cause; next update in 60 minutes." Posting after you sign off.

diego_prod: agreed, post the update. also please loop in legal for the enterprise notifications.

alice_sre_oncall: signed off. posting now.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2112345678 — status updated to 'Mitigated' by alice_sre_oncall at 2026-02-11T03:22:01Z. Postmortem required.

gary_night_oncall: I'm taking over incident monitoring for the night shift. handoff notes: rollback done, pins applied, probe hotfix deployed, TTL lowered to 15s. watch for any re-intro of v3.12. contact list: ben_net_eng, elaine_reliability, alice_sre_oncall.

alice_sre_oncall: thanks gary — adding on-call runbook items to the incident doc and capturing timelines. will assign postmortem owner tomorrow.

carmen_support: closing customer comms loop: all impacted customers notified, two with residual errors have dev tickets assigned.

ben_net_eng: follow-up: I'll propose a change to routing policy evaluation (quorum + backoff) and add canary step to test AZ probe behavior before global rollout.

alice_sre_oncall: good. incident remains 'Monitoring' until 03:59 UTC, then we'll close if stable. great teamwork. :clap:
